invariants.rationale: The method likely expects a non-null tile to add an object group.
tileElement is dereferenced inside the method, implying it should not be null.
If an 'objectgroup' child is present, its name should match 'objectgroup'.
Getting children by name should always return a non-negative size (possibly zero).

If getChildByName is called and not null, it is indeed not null. (Trivially true and can be considered a type check, though not strictly meaningful in practice, included here due to program context limitations.)
